comps.spec: Water tank, 2–6 litres with a screw cap
Low-water float with a magnet and reed switch (many ultrasonic models)
Small 12–24V DC fan that pushes the mist out

Heater, about 200–400W, in warm-mist and hybrid models (the Levoit LV600HH is rated 280W); steam vaporizers with electrodes, like the Vicks V150, have no separate heater — current passes through the water, so never run or test one
Plug-in adapter or internal supply, often 24–48V for the mist driver
Mist driver board with a power transistor and a piezo disc (about 1.7 MHz)
Small pump that lifts water to the wicks on some evaporative models (the Levoit Superior 6000S, fed from its 24V adapter)
CR2025 coin cell in the remote of the Levoit LV600HH; a swallowed coin cell can burn through a child's throat in as little as two hours, so keep it from children
